none: PAS SWYOR-54FC42: Roman coin; nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper alloy Roman coin: a nummus of the House of Constantine, dating from AD 324 - 330, Reece period 16. Probably PROVIDENTIAE CAESS reverse type. The reverse depicts a camp gate but the reverse legend is illegible. However, the obeverse legend does not appear to be split, making CAESS more likely than AVGG. The mint is also unknown.
